aiReview.tagline: Pre-send checks for email, chat, and texts
aiReview.description: Runs local and AI-backed checks in compose so leaked secrets, wrong recipients, and AI-sounding copy are caught before send.
pros: Official site documents a Chrome extension plus Mac app with free and paid plans.
Product is software/SaaS for message safety, not VPN or hosting infrastructure.
Curated list dates the claimed sale window as Nov 24, 2026 through Dec 1, 2026, which is in-season.
cons: Fetched vendor page content does not mention Black Friday, Cyber Monday, a 2026 season year, or a coupon code.
Deal terms currently exist only in a third-party deal list, which is not sufficient to approve.

# SubsDay

Formerly Subscription Day

A small but so useful app to keep track of your paid subscriptions and analyze statistics for Mac & iOS

[](https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/subscription-day-calendar/id6743316600?mt=12)

Available for macOS 14.0+ & iOS 17.0+

## Features

### Intuitive Interface

No complicated lists. View your subscriptions and upcoming charges right on a mini calendar.

### Multi-Currency Support

We support 168 currencies. Add subscriptions in various currencies, and we’ll convert them to a single currency at the current exchange rate.

### Fast Adding

Just enter the subscription name, and the app will find the logo, pick a color, and select the category for you.
